commits.message:
Feature/gh aw 3 (#763)

* Add protected-files fallback handling to workflow

Update sync_open_prs_with_main workflow to avoid pushing changes to protected files. Adds protected_files_policy: "fallback-to-issue" to GH_AW_SAFE_OUTPUTS_HANDLER_CONFIG in the lock file, and documents the new protected-files: fallback-to-issue option and fallback behavior in the workflow README. Also updates the workflow lock metadata (frontmatter hash). This ensures merges that would modify protected files create an issue instead of force-pushing changes to PR branches.

* Add triage_incoming_bug_reports workflow lockfile

Add a new GitHub Actions workflow for triaging incoming bug reports (.github/workflows/triage_incoming_bug_reports.md) and its compiled lockfile (.github/workflows/triage_incoming_bug_reports.lock.yml). The lockfile was auto-generated by gh-aw (v0.62.5) and provisions a full agent pipeline using the GitHub Copilot CLI: setup, safe-outputs MCP server, MCP gateway, agent execution, threat detection, artifact upload, and conclusion steps (comments/labels/discussions). DO NOT EDIT the lockfile directly — update the .md source and run `gh aw compile` as noted in the generated header.

* Add changelog workflow documentation

Remove the existing auto_change_log.yml workflow and add auto_change_log.md documenting the changelog automation. The new markdown describes goals and step-by-step behavior for generating CHANGELOG.md with git-chglog, smart diff detection to avoid timestamp-only PR noise, branch/PR conventions, required PR body content, triggers (release, push on main, workflow_dispatch), permissions, and constraints. This commit moves the workflow implementation details into a readable spec for the automation and documents installation/usage notes and expected behavior.

* Add update_docker_netsnmp_versions workflow

Add a new gh-aw-generated workflow (update_docker_netsnmp_versions.md/.lock.yml) that schedules and runs an agent to update Docker Net-SNMP versions, including safe-outputs config (title prefix [docker-netsnmp-update]) and full activation/agent/detection/conclusion steps. Also trim automated PR labels for the coverage-autofix workflow: remove the additional labels (coverage, tests, cpp, python) in both the .md and the compiled .lock.yml, and update the gh-aw metadata hash in the compiled coverage lock file.

@@ -0,0 +1,97 @@
+---
+name: Update Changelog
+concurrency:
+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+on:
+  release:
+    types: [published]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - main
+    paths:
+      - .github/workflows/auto_change_log.md
+      - .chglog/**
+  skip-if-match:
+    query: 'is:pr is:open head:automation/update-changelog label:documentation label:automated-pr'
+permissions:
+  actions: read
+  contents: read
+safe-outputs:
+  create-pull-request:
+    title-prefix: "[changelog] "
+    labels: [documentation, automated-pr]
+    draft: false
+    preserve-branch-name: true
+    if-no-changes: "ignore"
+timeout-minutes: 30
+engine:
+  id: copilot
+  model: auto
+network:
+  allowed: [defaults, github]
+tools:
+  bash: true
+---
+
+# Smart Changelog Update
+
+Generate and open a changelog update PR only when substantive changelog content has changed.
+
+## Goals
+
+- Keep `CHANGELOG.md` updated from git tags and commits using `git-chglog`.
+- Avoid noise PRs when only timestamp/header differences would change.
+- Keep one long-lived automation branch for easy updates.
+- Produce a high-signal summary by analyzing commit titles/messages and PR titles.
+
+## Steps
+
+1. Prepare tooling and history:
+   - Ensure full git history and tags are available.
+   - If `git-chglog` is missing, install it with:
+     - `go install github.com/git-chglog/git-chglog/cmd/git-chglog@latest`
+
+2. Generate candidate changelog content:
+   - `git-chglog --config .chglog/config.yml -o CHANGELOG.tmp`
+
+3. Build commit intelligence context for summary quality:
+  - Determine the comparison range using the latest reachable tag when possible.
+  - Extract commit titles and full commit messages for the range.
+  - If commit messages reference PRs or issue numbers, include those references in your reasoning.
+  - Group changes into themes inferred from commit titles/messages (for example: bug fixes, CI/workflows, docs, dependencies, tests).
+
+4. Perform smart diff detection:
+   - If `CHANGELOG.md` exists and starts with `Last Updated:`, compare against the old file with the first two lines removed.
+   - Otherwise compare against the full existing file.
+   - If no substantive difference exists, stop with no-op.
+
+5. If substantive changes exist, build final `CHANGELOG.md`:
+   - Add a header line: `Last Updated: <UTC timestamp>`
+   - Add one blank line
+   - Append the generated changelog body from `CHANGELOG.tmp`
+
+6. Create or update a PR with:
+   - Branch: `automation/update-changelog`
+   - Base: `main`
+   - Title: `Update CHANGELOG.md`
+   - Commit message: `chore(docs): update changelog`
+
+## Pull Request Body Requirements
+
+Include:
+
+- Trigger source (`release`, `push`, or `workflow_dispatch`)
+- Whether a release tag triggered this run (if available)
+- Summary of notable top-level sections changed in `CHANGELOG.md`
+- A concise, commit-driven "What changed" summary derived from commit titles/messages
+- A "Grouped themes" section showing categorized changes inferred from commit text
+- Mention of notable PR numbers/issues inferred from commit references when available
+- A note that timestamp-only changes are filtered out
+
+## Constraints
+
+- Only modify `CHANGELOG.md`.
+- Do not make unrelated code or workflow edits.
+- If generation fails due to missing tags/history, report clearly and stop.
\ No newline at end of file

commits.message:
Improve changelog and release note workflows

Update changelog and release-notes workflow docs to make generation resilient to missing external commit APIs by relying on local git history and commands. Add explicit base-selection priority (explicit override, stable-vs-prerelease logic, semantic fallback, repo root) and validation to avoid equal base/current tags and to never pick a prerelease base for a stable release when an earlier stable exists. Enhance commit extraction to include changed file paths for better categorization, prefer path-based classification when conflicting, log the selected base/range, and fall back gracefully if tags/history are unavailable. Update release notes template and guidance to emphasize user-facing changes, include a "Compared to:" line, and prefer concise runtime/API summaries over CI/dependency churn.
